corrective_actions.on_time_pct: Agree a recovery plan on delivery dates; review production capacity and booking-in slots; consider air-freight or split shipments for critical lines.
corrective_actions.fill_rate_pct: Review order-quantity commitments and raw-material availability; set minimum fill-rate expectations in the next PO cycle.
corrective_actions.defect_pct: Trigger a quality review: root-cause analysis, increased inspection sampling and a corrective-action report (CAPA) from the vendor.
corrective_actions.cost_variance_abs_pct: Reconcile invoices to agreed PO prices; hold payment on disputed lines and confirm price-change approvals.
corrective_actions.lead_time_cv: Review planning assumptions and critical-path steps with the vendor; agree a more realistic and stable lead-time commitment.
